responsibility: This file provides the PRU target’s RTL predicates and special predicates that drive pattern matching in the machine description. It classifies supported comparison operators, immediate forms, multiply and I/O register operands, CTABLE-related constants, program-memory references, load/store-multiple PARALLELs, and byte-pattern constants, supplying the semantic tests that pru.md and auxiliary md fragments use to recognize legal PRU addressing, branching, and instruction operands.
